## Implementation Notes

Create docs/adr/<next-number>-version-bump-design.md. Determine the next ADR number by inspecting existing ADRs (likely docs/adr/0014-* if 0013 is the latest verified ADR — verify via `ls docs/adr/ | sort | tail -3`).

Structure:

## Title
Version-bump design + SC5(c) carve-out for integration-review provenance skip

## Status
Accepted

## Context
- Epic f691-681e shifts the merge pipeline in two ways that affect existing contracts:
  (a) Version-bump moves from post-merge direct-to-main (legacy) to pre-merge source-branch HEAD commit (S5).
  (b) Integration review at ci.yml:llm-review gains a provenance-aware skip path (S3) — same job invocation surface, but execution outcome becomes data-dependent.
- Both changes are documented as "contract-preserving behavior changes" under SC5(c).

## Decision

### (a) Version-bump timing
Chose: BUMP-BEFORE-FINAL-REVIEW on source branch.
Rejected: bump-AFTER-final-review with branch-protection re-review-dismissal (undermines SC5(a) manual-review signal integrity).
Rejected: two-PR pattern (separate version-bump PR; over-engineering, conflicts with single-trailer model).

Rationale: see S5 ticket DESIGN_DECISION comment. Trade-off: every PR review now includes a one-line version-bump commit at the tip; minimal reviewer-fatigue cost (one-line diff).

### (b) SC5(c) carve-out for S3
S3 modifies ci.yml:llm-review behavior from "always run on session→main" to "conditionally skip". This is a CONTRACT-PRESERVING BEHAVIOR CHANGE under SC5(c) — the job invocation surface is unchanged, but execution outcome (run vs. skip) is now data-dependent on verify-session-provenance.sh.

Rationale: the alternative (running the review redundantly on already-covered commits) is the regression being fixed. The carve-out applies narrowly to this case.

## Consequences
- Version-bump commits land on source branch; downstream `git pull origin main` semantics unaffected.
- ci.yml:llm-review may skip dispatch on provenanced PRs; check-run conclusion reports 'skipped' with summary listing covered sub-PRs.
- verify-session-provenance.sh exit-code semantics (0/1/2 + new 3 from S7) become a load-bearing contract.
